name: captcha with zero mail_wait yields joey
spec: "joey": a CAPTCHA challenge was met on this run (captcha_seen true) — the submit probably did not go through and Joey must finish it (Edge hand-off, queue line, push). This wins over everything, also when mail_wait is positive.

spec: "pending": otherwise (mail_wait 0, None or negative; no CAPTCHA) — record `unconfirmed` with receipt pending: no queue line, no push, no waiting; receipt_confirm confirms it later.

name: receipt_pending exactly true means pending
spec: "pending" when `result["receipt_pending"]` is exactly true (log only: no queue line, no push).

name: receipt_pending false means joey
spec: "joey" otherwise (queue line + push as before) — also when the key is missing, false, null, 0, or the string "true".

name: receipt_pending numeric 1 is not exactly true
spec: "pending" when `result["receipt_pending"]` is exactly true (log only: no queue line, no push); "joey" otherwise (queue line + push as before) — also when the key is missing, false, null, 0, or the string "true".
why: The spec requires 'exactly true' and enumerates 0 and "true" as non-true, but does not say whether the number 1 counts; under an identity check it is joey, under truthiness it is pending.
